summary:
Accepted design, as of the cited revision, for FS-GG/.github#5136 (Outcome #4730): docs/coordination/2026-10-31-board-reconciler-design.md, merged by PR #5139 after seven independent review rounds; Root's rulings are recorded as PR comments and listed in its section 13. Read the document before implementing any piece; this record only indexes it.

Shape. One F# command, board-v2 tend (the name avoids the V1 kernel `reconcile`), reads Project 3 and native issue/PR facts in batched GraphQL (about 9-10 requests at 222 items, 16-20 at 500, derived from a live mix), runs a pure derivation whose only clock is the snapshot time, and emits a typed plan with three classes: Apply (absent-value fills and mechanically safe Status moves, each with a recorded preimage and named reversal), Propose (written once per stable ID as append-only comments on #4985; the drift observer stays the only body writer), and Refuse/Unknown (never a pass). It never closes an issue: a closed TendChange type plus a transport mutation allowlist make issue mutations unconstructible.

Derivation decisions. Work level is structural (sub-issues make an Outcome; a leaf under a Project 3 parent is a Delivery after a 24-hour settle window; a differing declaration is refused). Track: a declared Track wins; inheritance (T1i) is a heuristic kept out of the unattended starting set until a 7-day plan-only comparison shows at most 5% disagreement over undeclared pairs; T1f Follow-up applies only to undeclared, parentless, settled cards. Status: S3/S3b move only on a strict linkage_of() verdict naming exactly one Delivery; S4 only when nothing is linked; S9 fills Backlog, or Ready from a Root-account intended-fields line; S1 is a backstop Done writer 15 minutes after closure (amends decision 2); Blocked is never written except closed to Done; the Outcome roll-up is limited to Backlog, Ready and In progress. Derivation runs to a fixpoint with settled-input fallbacks, transitive deferral and an expiry (3 runs or 24 hours) into proposals; idempotence settles within k applications and liveness holds over the enabled rules.

Write path. Shares migration-apply's custody discipline with an item-scoped precondition (immediate re-read including deciding PR facts, durable possible-send custody, one send, readback, no resend); GitHub has no compare-and-swap, so a one-round-trip window remains and is documented. Every Project 3 writer takes one flock(2) lock at $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/fsgg/board-writer-<project>.lock (the old Path.GetTempPath() lock followed TMPDIR, so writers could miss each other: #5126). The merge gate waits up to 60 s, then writes a deferred-transition record (deferred -> possible-send -> verified, terminal superseded/refused/not-applicable) replayed in merge order with the newest record per Delivery, plus a read-only possible-send sweep. Runs on fdev (private binding and Root's PAT), hourly plus post-merge, dry-run by default with a per-rule enable file and a contract-amendment gate.

Rollout is eleven phase 2 PRs: lock and gate replay first, then derivation, reads, writer (#5123), proposals, contract amendment, engine release and installed qualification, timer, row-retirement design (a prerequisite for unattended auto-enroll, since binding rows are append-only under a 500 cap), auto-enroll (needs #5113 and #5120), and pair-by-pair retirement of the Python observers under #5094. Follow-ups recorded at approval: enable T1d together with the contract-amendment PR; measure T1i disagreement over undeclared pairs only.

Limits: a design decision, not implementation, deployment or current board state; parameters and rule ids change only by reviewed edits to the document.
title: Board reconciler (board-v2 tend): accepted design for deriving, planning and safely applying Project 3 fixes
